messages:
tara.k: Hi team — had a CT scan in Athens tonight during a family visit. Hospital offered to bill insurer directly but wants a company authorization form + invoice with VAT and IBAN. I paid 120 out of pocket. Can People Ops provide a one-page authorization and advise on what to upload for HSA reimbursement?

leo.benefits: Sorry that happened. We can produce an authorization letter that includes policy #, claims intake email, and a note authorizing the provider to contact the insurer for coverage verification. We dont provide guarantees of payment. For HSA: submit itemized invoice + proof of payment (card or bank), and a description of service.

claims_bot: Auto-guidance: Submit claim at https://benefits.redwood.com/claims -> "International reimbursement". Required: itemized invoice, proof of payment, provider bank details if direct billing, date/currency, and conversion evidence. Processing typically 3-6 weeks.

marta.hr: If this was during a work trip, attach calendar invite or boarding passes when you file to request expedited review.

ethan.claims: Tip: ask the hospital to email the invoice to claims@redwood.com so we can attach directly to the claim and they can pursue direct billing. If they insist on an IBAN, include that in your DM to leo so he can add it to the authorization.

tara.k: Thanks 2014 sending invoice now. Could you add a Spanish/Greek contact note? They prefer Greek.

leo.benefits: I will add Greek-language short line: "Παρακαλούμε επικοινωνήστε με claims@redwood.com για επαλήθευση κάλυψης" (please contact claims@redwood.com to verify coverage). Sending letter in DM now.

tara.k: Got it, clinic accepted the letter and will email claims. Appreciate the fast help :raised_hands:
